entities.name: Matoc
entities.description: A human barbarian and lavamancer from Auror in the Pardic Mountains of Otaria, grandfather of Kamahl and Jeska and friend of Balthor Rockfist.

entities.name: Balthor Rockfist
entities.description: A dwarf who befriended Matoc, joined his clan, and forged him a blade from Urza's Staff.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Matoc's grandson, who inherited the blade.

entities.name: Urza's Staff
entities.description: Source of the metal from which Balthor forged Matoc's blade.

entities.name: Auror
entities.description: Village in the Pardic Mountains where Matoc's clan lived.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion that left wastelands where Matoc fought war hounds.

events.summary: Matoc and Balthor meet while fighting Phyrexian war hounds and head home to Otaria.
events.quote: The two of them dispatched the constructs quickly and began their long trek home to Otaria .

events.summary: Matoc invites Balthor to join his clan, and Balthor passes the challenge.
events.quote: Balthor underwent the challenge to join the tribe and passed with no trouble.

events.summary: Balthor forges Matoc a blade from Urza's Staff.
events.quote: Balthor forged Matoc a blade from Urza 's Staff.

relations.quote: He was also a friend of Balthor Rockfist .
